newsitem.title: UK: Norway's Oseberg to load equiv 40.8 cargoes in JulY.
newsitem.headline: Norway's Oseberg to load equiv 40.8 cargoes in JulY.

text.p: Norway's Oseberg crude system is due to load the equivalent of 40.8 standard cargoes of 500,000 barrels in July, traders said on Friday.
They said the programme consisted of 24 cargoes of 600,000 barrels, six of 500,000 barrels and one each of two million and one million barrels.
The Oseberg system was due to load the equivalent of 30.7 standard cargoes in June.
June volumes were depressed by planned maintenance shutdowns, traders said.
Oseberg loaded the equivalent of 44.2 cargoes in May.
